author: Left_Fist
body: Yeah it’s worth it. You always want to maximize your farm gear.

author: petr1petr
body:
yes, it is worth it - if you can survive while dual wielding (yes, you can)

it is reduced to some 65% - so with good quality and lvl, it will give you more than just 1 piece.

We have tested it many times - three people got pretty much same results

author: 1fiveWhiskey
body: I'm currently dual wielding a master forged venin and a lvl 10 ornate one. With xp shrine and potion I got 46mil xp from a Heimdall. With a single venin with the same boosts I was seeing around 25mil. I'd say it's worth it.

author: McTrouserPants
body:
You do not get any more orns dual weilding gear.....i just looked at my godforged questing and its 56 percent orns bonus.   I tossed it on OH and it dropped to 25 percent.  Since this game compounds multipliers 2x 25 percent weapons would be 1.25 x 1.25 which is 1.56 or 56 percent bonus.

No diff

author: klako1234
body:
There is penalty when you dual wield, you get reduced bonus. The penalty seems to be more than the standard -35% for other stat.

Based on the in-game displayed bonus, it is not worth it. To check the value of reduced bonus, wield two weapon without orn bonus. Then change one of them to the venin. You should see that the bonus is lower than normal.

Now calculate what you will get if you wield two of them. i.e. (1+x) \* (1+x)

EDIT: Looks like several people has reported that there is benefit to dual wield based on testing. I guess this is display bug?
